That's record revenue and ~$118B of annual operating cash flow, against which the ~36.6× trailing P/E at $222.70 is full but defensible for a franchise with that cash generation. Because my research was weaker than I'd like — no fresh Q4 call detail, holiday-quarter guidance, or Greater China commentary confirmed from a primary source — I sized the position conservatively at roughly half the per-order allowance (22 shares, $4,906) rather than the maximum ~$5,000, kept the limit essentially at market, and stayed entirely within the mandate (AAPL only, buy only, no money moved out, $4,906 of the $10,000 daily budget used, leaving room for an INTC order if warranted). Anyone reviewing this should note that the thesis rests on the FY2024 10-K fundamentals rather than on verified current-quarter news.
